methods: Direct review of public Telegram channel previews
Sequence screening around the 4/5 August midnight transition
Canonical post-link resolution from public preview link targets
Exclusion of precise frontline, targeting, and map detail

records.quote_locator: Telegram post body, heading and opening paragraphs
records.excerpt_original: Хроника специальной военной операции. За 4 августа 2026 года
records.summary: Rybar published a daily conflict chronicle containing attributed descriptions of strikes and operations.

lineage.description: The post aggregates multiple unnamed and linked upstream reports and embeds map links.

records.safety_note: No map geometry, granular frontline positions, or targeting detail was retained.

records.preview_date_basis: The item appears before the public channel sequence crosses midnight into 5 August 2026.

source_checks.notes: A post explicitly dated 4 August 2026 was found after the displayed 18:00 boundary, but the public preview supplied no timezone-bearing datetime.
Visible posts near the boundary either duplicated the previous campaign's items, fell outside the new interval, or overlapped official/infrastructure shards.
The public preview exposed a sequence spanning the midnight transition, but not timezone-bearing datetimes.
A caption explicitly dated 5 August 2026 was found; its linked strike scheme was not collected for safety and provenance reasons.

artifact_policy.reason: No media or page bytes were downloaded, hashed, or stored. Visual strike schemes and videos were intentionally not captured.

coverage_gaps: Telegram public previews displayed minute-level clock times but did not expose timezone-bearing datetimes, so exact inclusion within the UTC window remains uncertain.
Public channel previews are rolling windows and do not guarantee exhaustive recovery of every overnight post.
Several posts named official or local upstream sources without stable canonical source-item URLs in the preview.
Visual media and granular operational descriptions were excluded to avoid preserving targeting-enabling or sensitive geodata.
The bounded source check is not an exhaustive scan of Russian milblogger publishing.

excluded_results.description: Dva Majors and Rybar items already represented in the preceding campaign were not duplicated.
Posts centered on granular frontline positions, active-unit movements, strike geometry, or actionable infrastructure detail were not registered.
Pure relays of Russian official statements were minimized and their official upstreams were left to the Russian-official shard.

follow_up_task_proposals.reason: Identity, ownership, methodology, correction behavior, independence, and historical accuracy require evidence-backed review.
Use a connector or API that exposes Telegram's original timezone-bearing datetime metadata to resolve exact window inclusion.
Extract only broad, attributed observations after exact publication-time and upstream-lineage review.

safety_notes: No precise current positions, movement tracks, strike coordinates, map geometry, or targeting instructions were stored.
No truth assessment, reliability score, territorial conclusion, or report narrative was produced.
